t: Adds APIs to create publishers, verify that a publisher owns a domain, and associate registry records with a publisher. Publishers can approve or reject each association.

Adds skill packages and skill source sync for agent skill records. Upload a skill package (ZIP) or sync SKILL.md or the full package from Amazon S3 or GitHub. GetRegistryRecord returns a short-lived download URL and SHA-256 checksum. GitHub sources use OAuth 2.0 user authorization.
Adds support for OAuth2 Authorization Server Metadata (RFC 8414) discovery URLs in custom JWT authorizer.
AWS Agent Registry is improving recently launched custom metadata schema feature to make shared attributes easier to manage.

AWS Agent Registry adds support for custom metadata. Define a typed metadata schema on your registry and attach structured key-value metadata to registry records. Schemas are additive only. Enforcement is progressive. Records show a compliance status computed against the current schema.
AWS Agent Registry becomes Generally Available
